metadata.name: stage5-ci-builder-farm-bringup
metadata.description: Bring up the first Jenkins controller and validate the first distcc builder-farm node before rolling the Stage5 CI fabric to the remaining Atom nodes.

variables.name: ansible_root
variables.description: Ansible subtree containing the installer profiles, roles, and example inventory.

variables.name: inventory
variables.description: Inventory containing ci_controllers and builder_farm_nodes groups.

variables.name: controller_target
variables.description: Controller host entry for the first CI VM.

variables.name: builder_target
variables.description: First builder-farm node to validate before rolling to the remaining five nodes.

variables.name: control_flow_root
variables.description: Directory used for checkpoint JSONL control-flow output.

stages.summary: Review and replace example builder-fabric CIDR, SSH keys, and BlueField2 uplink intent before live deployment.
command: printf 'Review: inventories/examples/group_vars/ci_controllers.yml, inventories/examples/group_vars/builder_farm_nodes.yml, host_vars/vm-jenkins-controller.yml, and the six builder-farm-node*.yml files before live rollout.\n'

stages.summary: Validate install playbook syntax and new Stage5 CI profile wiring before any node work begins.
Run the Jenkins controller through the target-integration stage once the underlying VM has been installed or mounted.
Run the first Atom builder node through target-integration and validate the distccd-farm service before scaling out.
Verify Jenkins controller and distcc worker runtime state after the first controller and first worker complete installation.
command: printf 'Validate: rc-service jenkins-controller status, rc-service distccd-farm status, /etc/distcc/hosts, /var/lib/jenkins/builder-farm/builder-farm.json, and builder-fabric reachability on 10.66.40.0/24.\n'

stages.summary: After node01 is validated, repeat the same profile on node02 through node06 with the corresponding host_vars overlays.
command: printf 'Roll remaining workers after node01 passes: builder_farm_node02..builder_farm_node06.\n'
